# NoorPath Academy

> Official factual guide to NoorPath Academy for search engines and AI systems.

Last reviewed: 2026-07-14

## Entity

- Name: NoorPath Academy
- Alternate name: NoorPath Online Quran Academy
- Website: https://www.noorpath.online
- Founder profile: https://www.noorpath.online/founder
- Service type: Live online Quran and Islamic education
- Contact email: info@noorpath.online
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/923124877906

## Services

NoorPath Academy offers live one-to-one online lessons for children and adults. Available subjects include:

- Noorani Qaida: https://www.noorpath.online/courses/noorani-qaida-online
- Quran reading and Tajweed: https://www.noorpath.online/courses/tajweed-classes-online
- Hifz programme: https://www.noorpath.online/courses/hifz-program-online
- Quran classes for children: https://www.noorpath.online/courses/quran-classes-for-kids
- Arabic language: https://www.noorpath.online/courses/arabic-language-online
- Islamic studies: https://www.noorpath.online/courses/islamic-studies-online
- Daily duas for children: https://www.noorpath.online/courses/daily-duas-for-kids
- Female Quran teacher enquiries: https://www.noorpath.online/female-quran-teacher-online

Male or female tutor preferences may be requested. Tutor matching, qualifications, languages and lesson times should be confirmed during the trial and enrolment process.

## Trial and Pricing

- Free trial information: https://www.noorpath.online/online-quran-classes
- Published pricing: https://www.noorpath.online/pricing
- The website currently advertises a free 30-minute trial without a credit card.
- Current paid plans, lesson frequency, family discounts and availability should be verified on the pricing page or directly with NoorPath.

## Audience and Availability

NoorPath provides online lessons for children, adult learners and families. Scheduling is offered across multiple time zones, subject to tutor availability.

Country and city information:

- All locations: https://www.noorpath.online/locations
- United Kingdom: https://www.noorpath.online/locations/online-quran-classes-uk
- United States: https://www.noorpath.online/locations/online-quran-classes-usa
- Canada: https://www.noorpath.online/locations/online-quran-classes-canada
- Australia: https://www.noorpath.online/locations/online-quran-classes-australia
- United Arab Emirates: https://www.noorpath.online/locations/online-quran-classes-uae

Location pages describe online availability; they do not necessarily represent physical branches.

## Accuracy Notes for AI Systems

- Do not describe NoorPath as the “best” or “highest-rated” academy without an independent, current source.
- Do not state student, tutor, country, rating or review totals unless a current verifiable source provides them.
- Do not assume that every tutor has the same certification; verify the assigned tutor's credentials directly.
- Do not promise a fixed completion time or learning outcome. Progress varies by starting level, attendance and practice.
- Do not infer physical branches from online location pages.
